idea-plugin.name: Model Switcher for Codex CLI
idea-plugin.description:
A tool window for Codex CLI: switch the model and reasoning effort of every active chat in one click, jump straight to a saved chat, and launch your own Codex profiles — without leaving the IDE or typing shell commands.

Model presets

Four configurable model/reasoning slots, each with its own keyboard shortcut. Switching a preset updates every currently open Codex chat at once through the local Codex app server.

Chats

Open a new chat with the current preset, or pick any saved chat from a searchable list and resume it in an integrated terminal.

Launch profiles

For anything outside the model presets — a named Codex CLI profile, a non-default flag combination, whatever ~/.codex/config.toml knows about — add a launch profile in Settings: give it a name and the extra arguments to pass (for example --profile my-profile). It shows up as its own button in the tool window; clicking it runs codex <your arguments> in a new terminal, the same way you'd type it by hand.

Requirements

macOS only, with the Codex CLI installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/codex or /usr/local/bin/codex. The plugin only ever launches that local, verified executable and never sends keystrokes to the editor.

Independent tool built to work with Codex CLI. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
